verdicts.title: Prenilpotent pairs in the E10 root system
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: Tits has defined Kac-Moody groups for all root systems, over all commutative rings with unit. A central concept is the idea of a prenilpotent pair of (real) roots. In particular, writing down his group presentation explicitly would require knowing all the Weyl-group orbits of such pairs. We show that for the hyperbolic root system E10 there are so many orbits that any attempt at direct enumeration is impractical. verdicts.title: Cohomology of Complements of Toric Arrangements Associated to Root Systems
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: We compute the cohomology of the complement of toric arrangements associated to root systems as representations of the corresponding Weyl groups.
